title: Playa Blanca
meta_description: Find the perfect Rosemary Beach, FL vacation rental at “Playa Blanca”, a luxury 4-bed, 3.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 14 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities coveted Rosemary Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Heated Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1-May 1) -Entertain Outdoors with Covered Lanai and Outdoor TV -Sonos Home Sound System -6 Adult Bikes Included for Exploring Neighborhood Paths -In addition to being a part of a Private Beach Access Community, Playa Blanca guests have access to Rosemary Beach’s 4 Community Pools – 3 Outdoor and 1 Indoor. Discover the epitome of sophistication and elegance at Playa Blanca, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom sanctuary nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach. This three-level luxury home is a haven for up to 14 guests, offering a truly exceptional retreat. Outside, the meticulously manicured courtyard and a private pool welcome you to a world of tranquility and opulence. The outdoor entertainment areas are perfect for unwinding, and the interiors boast rich, natural finishes that will impress even the most discerning guests. No detail has been spared in this stunning abode. The first level encompasses the living, dining, and meal preparation areas, exuding understated elegance with pristine lines, custom lighting, and rich textures. The well-appointed kitchen features integrated appliances and a gas range on a kitchen island, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. A breakfast area with a plush banquette backs up to the kitchen counter, providing a cozy space for informal meals. Large windows flood the rooms with natural light, and the live-edge dining table comfortably seats 10. The living area, defined by beautiful wood tones, plush seating, and carefully curated art, beckons guests to relax. Stunning arched doorways lead to the enchanting courtyard with its resort-style pool and a covered lanai, where outdoor seating invites you to unwind and soak in the serene atmosphere. Moving up the stairs to the second level, you’ll find two lavish sleeping spaces. The first is a king bedroom with a side balcony and a private ensuite with a spa shower and two standalone vanities. The second is another king bedroom with a side balcony and a private ensuite with a shower/tub combination and a single vanity. The laundry room with extra counter space is conveniently located on this level. Don’t miss the spacious balcony with comfortable seating, offering a bird’s-eye view of the courtyard and pool area below. On the top floor, you’ll discover two more inviting sleeping spaces, each with two queen beds and one twin bed, all with standalone frames. They share a bath with a walk-in shower and vanity. Days spent at Playa Blanca are destined for delight, with Rosemary Beach’s charm at your doorstep. Stroll along the boardwalk, enjoy the sun-kissed beaches, and explore the vibrant Town Center. The amphitheater and 30A’s eclectic venues provide entertainment, with a weekly Farmers Market and live music. Boutiques on Barrett Square await leisurely shoppers. Your escape to Playa Blanca is a promise of unparalleled luxury in a prime location. Home Layout First Floor Living Room Dining Room Kitchen Half Bathroom Second Floor King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Laundry Room King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Third Floor Two Queen Beds and Twin Bedroom - Shared Bathroom with Shower Only Two Queen Beds and Twin Bedroom - Shared Bathroom *Fireplace is not for guest use*
